methods.B0: ideal conversion: predicted DC = measured AC window mean
methods.B1: per-unit directional constant conversion efficiency estimated only on Test1

eta_charge: sum(DC reference means)/sum(AC means) over fit unit/charge windows
eta_discharge: sum(AC means)/sum(DC reference means) over fit unit/discharge windows
eta_interval: 0 < eta <= 1; invalid estimate is failure, no clipping
minimum_count_status: operational parameter availability check, not independent-sample adequacy
primary_metric: Test2 DC mean MAE (kW), equal-weight mean of per-unit MAE over identical scored windows
failure_policy: retain every sample; record invalid parameter and prediction failures; B0/B1 paired scores use same rows and report all-available B0 separately
test_usage: Test2 inspected previously for quality and inventory; this is a retrospective same-site holdout, not blind testing
scope: steady retrospective AC-to-DC conversion only, not capacity/SOC/task or cross-site validation
